title: 第552章 拒绝组队第551章 清醒了嘛
content_zh:
蔡明宇颤抖着起身，看着杨修的脸没勇气开口，直接双腿一软跪在地上猛猛磕头，杨修瞥了他一眼没多说什么转身走入乾元剑宗秘境内，罗素云和夏清幽紧随其后。
“哎呀！蔡老弟！杨兄弟都走了不需要再继续磕头了！”吴天昊上前一步拉了蔡明宇一下。
被吴天昊拉住的蔡明宇头脑完全恍惚，他盯着前方秘境入口缓了好久才缓过来，发现杨修已经离开了才敢在吴天昊的搀扶下起身。
“他……他不是乾元剑宗的夫子？”蔡明宇拉着吴天昊的胳膊难以置信的问道，吴天昊没有说话只是轻轻摇了摇头。
下午的战斗很是无趣，杨修觉得夏清幽没什么可以学习的地方，就带着夏清幽回到了乾元客栈，让杨修没想到的是他离场之后，观赛的各位大佬们只有吴天昊一个乾元剑宗宗主留在了剑斗场，其他人都跟着他回到了乾元客栈。
乾元客栈杨修房间门口，这里围满了人他们互相对视，竟然没有一个人敢敲门的，杨修知道门外有人，他以为会有人敲门，结果等了好久都没一个人敢伸手，索性就走到门口将门从里面直接打开了。
“吱呀～”房门发出一阵响声，众人听到声音吓了一跳，当他们看到杨修的脸出现在他们面前时，一个个笑着打招呼道：“杨公子！好久不见啊！”
杨修听到这句话一头黑线，心里吐槽一句“什么好久不见，明明今天才刚见过好吧！”，但这句话他没说出口，而是冷冷吐出三个字：“有事吗？”
陈老头是第一个接话的，他挤开人群走到前面说道：“杨兄弟！我有个想法！”
杨修摆摆手说道：“有话直说，没必要拐弯抹角！”
陈老头闻言脸上露出一个菊花般的笑容：“我想问问您，进入剑林之后能不能跟老头子我组个队？”
杨修闻言一愣，沉默了三秒问出一个让众人震惊的问题：“这剑林里面还能组队？难道不是各自带着自家弟子行动吗？”
陈老头闻言摆摆手说道：“非也！非也！剑林里的剑颇为神奇，有些强的剑需要强大的剑气才能得到他们的认可？”
杨修闻言来了兴趣，他摸着下巴问道：“喔？这么神奇？难不成这些剑有自己的思想？”
陈老头闻言点点头又摇摇头，杨修被他的弄的一头懵，他伸手拍了拍陈老头的肩膀问道：“别绕弯着，你这点头摇头的我看不懂！”
陈老头本想装的高深莫测一点，但被杨修直白的话弄的一愣，他尴尬的点点头说道：“也算是有意识吧！可以识别主人的强大与否，但是不能跟人交流！”
杨修闻言沉默下来，众人也不敢打扰，大概过了五秒，杨修环顾一圈问道：“你们这些人的目的都跟陈老一样？”
众人闻言纷纷点点头，杨修摆摆手说道：“如果是这样的话，就请回吧！夫子嘱咐过我，进入剑林之后有其他的事情要做！”
众人闻言纷纷面露失望，但没有一个人多说什么，杨修见众人散去打算将房门关好，但一个手按住了房门阻止了他，杨修抬头发现不是别人是刚比试完回来的罗素云，此刻她脸上带着些许愤怒。
杨修见状直接松开手说道：“关好房门！”

罗素云闻言面色更加阴沉了，她没有多说什么，而是走进房间将门关好，随后快速跟在杨修身后嚷嚷道：“小师叔！你和清幽为什么不等我？”
杨修回头慵懒的说道：“阳光太晒了，并且下午的战斗也太无聊的！”
罗素云听到杨修的解释没有放过杨修的趋势，而是指着自己说：“小师叔你看看我！我这么如花似玉，你就不怕我被一些心怀不轨的人盯上吗？”
杨修摇摇头这让罗素云很是挫败，她转头看向坐在木凳上的夏清幽，上前两步一屁股坐在夏清幽旁边，伸出手将夏清幽抱在怀里说道：“还有你！你这个小没良心的，小师叔走了也就罢了，你也不等我！”
夏清幽想说是杨修带她走的，但一抬头对上杨修威胁的眼神，有些委屈的低下头弱弱说道：“对不起！我知道错了素云！”
罗素云闻言想再说几句，杨修见状伸手拍了拍夏清幽说道：“叫什么素云啊！你要叫罗师姐！”
杨修的声音很快，让罗素云原本要说的话卡在了喉咙里，最后完全想不起来只能来一句：“对啊！你要叫我师姐！”
夏清幽很懂事的点点头，用柔柔的语气说：“对不起！小师姐！”
因为声音太好听的原因，罗素云一身的火气全部消失了，她激动的伸出手揉了揉夏清幽的脸蛋，嘴上还叫着：“哎呀！小清幽！你真的是太可爱了！”
夏清幽听到罗素云的话不知道怎么回，只能红着脸低下头不敢看罗素云，这更加让罗素云内心更加激动，她直接伸手将夏清幽从木凳上拉了起来说道：“跟师姐走！师姐带你转转乾元剑宗的夜市！”
杨修闻言也起身跟着两人下了楼，但当他刚踏出乾元客栈的门，罗素云便转过头来一脸认真的说道：“我们女孩子的聚会，你身为长辈和男人就不要参加了了吧！”
杨修闻言嘴角抽了抽“得！这小姑娘气性还挺大的！”，他摇摇头轻飘飘说道：“行！你们逛你们的！我就到处走走！”
“最好是！”罗素云吐出三个字便带着夏清幽快步离开了，杨修环顾一圈最后选择了和两人相反的方向。
乾元剑宗万金赌场内。
“快快快！押明天的输赢了！”
“明天的输赢有什么好压的？明天很多场都没有悬念好吧！”
“怎么没有悬念，这一场就不好说罗素云对战楚沧澜！”
“楚沧澜我知道！但这罗素云是谁？为啥这两人就五五开了？”
“罗素云是庆阳书院夫子的弟子，你们能问出这样的问题，就代表今天都没去看比赛吧，我跟你们讲这小姑娘可厉害了，今天遇上她的对手都轻松解决！要我看她的实力比楚沧澜还高了不少，要赢楚沧澜不在话下！”
“切！吹嘘谁不会？我还说楚沧澜无敌呢？你觉得这小姑娘厉害就压她呀！”

“好！我就押他赢！”
content_en:
Cai Mingyu stood up tremblingly. Looking at Yang Xiu's face, he didn't have the courage to speak. He knelt down on the ground and kowtowed violently. Yang Xiu glanced at him without saying anything and turned around and walked into the secret territory of the Qianyuan Sword Sect, followed closely by Russell Yun and Karen Xia.
"Oops! Brother Cai! Brother Yang is gone and there is no need to continue kowtowing!" Wu Tianhao stepped forward and pulled Cai Mingyu.
Cai Mingyu, who was pulled by Wu Tianhao, was completely in a daze. He stared at the entrance to the secret realm in front of him and waited for a long time before he recovered. Only when he found that Yang Xiu had left did he dare to get up with Wu Tianhao's help.
"He... he's not the master of the Qianyuan Sword Sect?" Cai Mingyu took Wu Tianhao's arm and asked in disbelief. Wu Tianhao didn't speak but shook his head gently.
The battle in the afternoon was very boring. Yang Xiu felt that Karen Xia had nothing to learn, so he took Karen Xia back to the Qianyuan Inn. What Yang Xiu didn't expect was that after he left the field, among the big guys watching, only Wu Tianhao, the leader of the Qianyuan Sword Sect, stayed in the sword arena, and the others followed him back to the Qianyuan Inn.
The door of Yang Xiu's room in Qianyuan Inn was crowded with people. They looked at each other, but no one dared to knock on the door. Yang Xiu knew that there was someone outside the door, and he thought someone would knock on the door. But after waiting for a long time, no one dared to reach out, so he simply walked to the door and opened the door directly from the inside.
"Creak~" The door made a sound, and everyone was startled when they heard the sound. When they saw Yang Xiu's face appeared in front of them, they all smiled and said hello: "Mr. Yang! Long time no see!"
When Yang Xiu heard this sentence, there was a dark line, and he complained in his mind, "Why haven't we seen each other for a long time? We just met today!" But he did not say this sentence, but coldly spit out three words: "Is something wrong?"
Old Man Chen was the first to answer. He pushed through the crowd and walked to the front and said, "Brother Yang! I have an idea!"
Yang Xiu waved his hand and said, "Speak directly if you have something to say, there is no need to beat around the bush!"
When Old Man Chen heard this, a chrysanthemum-like smile appeared on his face: "I want to ask you, can you form a team with me after entering the Sword Forest?"
Yang Xiu was stunned when he heard this. He was silent for three seconds and asked a question that shocked everyone: "Can we form a team in this sword forest? Aren't they each leading their own disciples?"
Old Man Chen waved his hand after hearing this and said: "No! No! The swords in the sword forest are quite magical. Some strong swords require strong sword energy to be recognized by them?"
Yang Xiu became interested when he heard this. He touched his chin and asked, "Oh? So magical? Could it be that these swords have their own thoughts?"
Old Chen nodded and shook his head when he heard this. Yang Xiu was confused by what he said. He reached out and patted Old Chen on the shoulder and asked, "Don't beat around the bush, I can't understand how you are nodding and shaking your head!"
Old Chen wanted to pretend to be a little more unpredictable, but he was stunned by Yang Xiu's straightforward words. He nodded awkwardly and said, "It can be considered conscious! It can identify whether the master is powerful or not, but it cannot communicate with others!"
Yang Xiu fell silent after hearing this, and no one dared to disturb him. After about five seconds, Yang Xiu looked around and asked, "Do you all have the same purpose as Mr. Chen?"
Everyone nodded after hearing this, and Yang Xiu waved his hand and said, "If that's the case, please come back! Master told me that I have other things to do after entering the Sword Forest!"
Everyone looked disappointed after hearing this, but no one said anything. When Yang Xiu saw everyone dispersed, he was about to close the door, but a hand pressed down on the door to stop him. Yang Xiu looked up and found that it was none other than Russell Yun, who had just returned from the competition. At this moment, she had a little anger on her face.
Upon seeing this, Yang Xiu immediately let go of his hand and said, "Close the door!"
Russell Yun's expression became even more gloomy when she heard this. She didn't say anything more, but walked into the room and closed the door. Then she quickly followed Yang Xiu and shouted, "Uncle Junior! Why didn't you and Qingyou wait for me?"Yang Xiu turned around and said lazily: "The sun is too hot, and the afternoon battle is too boring!"
When Russell Yun heard Yang Xiu's explanation, he did not let go of Yang Xiu's tendency. Instead, he pointed at himself and said, "Uncle, look at me! I am so beautiful, aren't you afraid that I will be targeted by some people with evil intentions?"
Yang Xiu shook her head, which made Russell Yun very frustrated. She turned to look at Karen Xia who was sitting on the wooden bench, took two steps forward and sat down next to Karen Xia, stretched out her hand to hold Karen Xia in her arms and said, "And you! You little heartless little thing, it's okay if my junior uncle is gone, and you won't wait for me!"
Karen Xia wanted to say that it was Yang Xiu who took her away, but when she raised her head and met Yang Xiu's threatening eyes, she lowered her head in grievance and said weakly: "I'm sorry! I know I was wrong about Su Yun!"
When Russell Yun heard this and wanted to say a few more words, Yang Xiu reached out and patted Karen Xia and said, "What is your name Su Yun! You want to call me Senior Sister Luo!"
Yang Xiu's voice was so fast that what Russell Yun was about to say got stuck in his throat. In the end, he couldn't remember it at all and could only say: "That's right! You have to call me senior sister!"
Karen Xia nodded sensibly and said in a soft tone: "I'm sorry! Little senior sister!"
Because the voice was so pleasant, all the anger in Russell Yun's body disappeared. She reached out excitedly and rubbed Karen Xia's face, shouting: "Oh! Little Karen! You are so cute!"
Karen Xia didn't know what to say when she heard Russell Yun's words. She could only blush and lower her head, not daring to look at Russell Yun. This made Russell Yun even more excited. She directly stretched out her hand to pull Karen Xia up from the wooden bench and said: "Follow senior sister! Senior sister will take you to the night market of Qianyuan Sword Sect!"
Upon hearing this, Yang Xiu also stood up and followed the two of them downstairs, but as soon as he stepped out of the door of Qianyuan Inn, Russell Yun turned his head and said seriously: "As an elder and a man, you should not attend our girls' party!"
When Yang Xiu heard this, the corner of his mouth twitched, "Yeah! This little girl is quite angry!" He shook his head and said lightly: "Okay! You go shopping in your place! I'll walk around!"
"It's best!" Russell Yun uttered three words and quickly left with Karen Xia. Yang Xiu looked around and finally chose the opposite direction to the two of them.
Inside the Qianyuan Jianzong Wanjin Casino.
"Quick, quick! Bet on tomorrow's outcome!"
"What's so stressful about winning or losing tomorrow? There won't be any suspense in many games tomorrow, okay!"
"Why is there no suspense? It's hard to say that Russell Yun will face Chu Canglan in this match!"
"I know Chu Canglan! But who is Russell Yun? Why did these two people get away with each other?"
"Russell Yun is a disciple of Master Qingyang Academy. If you can ask such a question, it means you didn't go to the game today. Let me tell you, this little girl is amazing. She easily defeated her opponents today! I think her strength is much higher than that of Chu Canglan. It's easy to beat Chu Canglan!"
"Tch! Who doesn't know how to brag? And I said Chu Canglan is invincible? If you think this little girl is great, just overpower her!"
"Okay! I'll bet on him to win!"
